name: @penguinharness/ape-rsi-toolkit
description: The APE RSI Toolkit: Large Language Models are Human-Level Prompt Engineers (Zhou et al., 2022, https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.01910), non-iterative forward generation with execution scoring — the proposer induces candidate instructions from input/output demonstrations, every candidate is measured on the frozen Benchmark, and the best is kept. Self-contained: it creates the Target's instruction slot, evaluates its own cells and writes the Evaluation Center's scoreboard.

penguin.description_zh: APE RSI 工具包：按论文《Large Language Models are Human-Level Prompt Engineers》（Zhou 等，2022，https://arxiv.org/abs/2211.01910）的非迭代前向生成与执行评分——提议者从输入 / 输出示例归纳候选指令，每个候选都在冻结的 Benchmark 上测量，保留最优者。自成一体：自行创建 Target 的指令槽、自行评测每个单元、写入评估中心的记分板。
penguin.short_description: APE RSI Toolkit: induce an instruction from examples.
penguin.short_description_zh: APE RSI 工具包：从示例归纳指令。

quick_start.prompt: Reproduce APE (Automatic Prompt Engineer, Zhou et al. 2022) on the house-style brief task that ships with the `ape-rsi-toolkit` Skill: a fresh agent, a 6-case Benchmark, and the score before and after.
quick_start.prompt_zh: 在 `ape-rsi-toolkit` 技能自带的「公司格式简报」任务上复现 APE（Automatic Prompt Engineer，Zhou 等，2022）：新建一个 Agent、一套 6 题的 Benchmark，给我看优化前后的分数。

penguin.title: APE RSI Toolkit
